ICE detention projects called wasteful by GAO report

The U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO) has found that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is wasting tens of millions of dollars on "uninformed" detention projects. The GAO report indicates that these funds were spent in a manner that did not align with effective practices or goals.
